item-01.reason: Passes alone 10/10 but fails in suite; cy.session cacheAcrossSpecs restored the admin session leaked from a prior test.

item-02.reason: Alert renders only when allergens is non-empty; the recipe has none, yet the assertion always expects it.

item-03.reason: Search API returned in 3960ms, right at the 4000ms command timeout, and the test passed on retry in a non-SSR app.

item-04.reason: SSR Nuxt page; first click at 540ms landed before hydration at 1020ms, no POST fired, passes on retry.

item-05.reason: Passes at 1280px locally, fails on 800px CI viewport where the button collapses into the overflow menu.

item-06.reason: Toast auto-dismissed at 1500ms before cy.get started at 1640ms because cy.screenshot delayed the assertion.

item-07.reason: Stored auth state token expired 2026-09-27, run on 2026-10-03 got 401 on /api/me and a redirect to login.

item-08.reason: API took 14902ms against a 15000ms timeout, flaky outcome with pass on retry in a non-SSR app.

item-09.reason: Opacity was read at 948ms mid 600ms transition (0.42) before reaching 1; flaky across attempts.

item-10.reason: Seed script never creates the 'Ancient Pottery' exhibit, so the link is absent from the DOM.

item-11.reason: Blanket uncaught:exception handler returning false suppressed an exception and had hidden it so the spec passed.

item-12.reason: CI config uses a 1000px viewport below the 1024px hamburger breakpoint, so the link is hidden; local passes at 1280px.

item-13.reason: Commit removed id adopt-now while the custom command in commands.js still uses it.

item-14.reason: SSR Next.js page; click at 610ms preceded hydration at 1040ms, no POST observed, passed on retry.

item-15.reason: Fixture references mem_301 but seed only has mem_401/402, so the API returns 404.

item-16.reason: Cached cy.session token expired 2026-09-25 versus a 2026-10-03 run, /api/session returned 401 and redirected to login.

item-17.reason: Submit POST returned ok but the server state remains draft even after reload, so the action did not persist.

item-18.reason: Passes alone 10/10; a worker-scoped fixture shares storage state so the earlier test's reading list entry leaks.

item-19.reason: Selector matches two buttons that have always coexisted, with no DOM change, so it is simply ambiguous.

item-20.reason: cy.intercept registered at 244ms after the request completed at 181ms, so the alias never observed it.

item-21.reason: Frozen clock and contract give 2 days but the API returned overdue_days 3, so the product computes the wrong value.

item-22.reason: Commit removed id assign-vehicle but the Page Object locator RentalPage.ts was not updated.

item-23.reason: Contract says 10% member discount but the API reports discount_applied false and total 50.00.

item-24.reason: Intercept matched and the application's own API returned 500 (database connection refused) on both attempts.

item-25.reason: The app's events API returned 502 on both attempts, so the list is empty; no route mocking involved.

item-26.reason: Strict mode violation: the Archive button resolves to 3 elements and has been ambiguous since the test was written.

item-27.reason: Late-fee notice renders only when late_fee_cents > 0 but the fixture has 0 and the assertion always expects it.

item-28.reason: Helper uses .catch(() => {}) on the visibility assertion, swallowing the rejection so the test passed silently.

item-29.reason: Archive POST returned 200 but the task is still archived:false after reload, so the action had no persisted effect.

item-30.reason: waitForEvent registered at 340ms after the download event fired at 311ms; the listener was set up after the click.
